entity_name: United Nations Security Council sanctions committees
notes: AUTHORITY POINTER, NOT A SCREENING LIST. The UN Security Council operates 15 current sanctions regimes, each managed by a committee that publishes its own listed individuals and entities; 31 regimes have been established since 1966, so terminated regimes exist and must not be treated as current. The authoritative entity-level list is the UN Security Council Consolidated List, which is NOT reproduced in this project.

authority: Council of the European Union / European Commission
notes: AUTHORITY POINTER, NOT A SCREENING LIST. The EU has over 40 different sanctions regimes in place; some are mandated by the UN Security Council and transposed at EU level, others are adopted autonomously by the EU. The authoritative entity-level list is the EU Consolidated List of persons, groups and entities subject to EU financial sanctions, which is NOT reproduced in this project.

source: OFAC - Sanctions Programs and Country Information (Active Sanctions Programs)
notes: CRITICAL CAVEAT RECORD. OFAC's active programs list includes programs that are thematic rather than country-based. These can designate persons and entities located in ANY country, including countries this project marks 'no_ofac_country_program_listed' in suppliers.csv. Therefore sanctions_reference_status in suppliers.csv must NEVER be read as 'this country carries no sanctions exposure' - it means only that no COUNTRY-based OFAC program bears that country's name. This row exists so that limitation is impossible to miss.
